Apple TV is currently airing a slate of new shows with an incredibly strong lineup, and another one is about to be added. 《Small Prophets》 is a British comedy that will premiere next week and has already earned a perfect 100% rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Here's the trailer.

《Small Prophets》 will premiere on Apple TV on October 7, and has already been a hit with audiences and critics before it even airs.

Last month, Apple TV did something quite rare: it acquired the streaming rights to an existing series from another network.

The British comedy 《Small Prophets》 premiered earlier this year in the UK and instantly became a ratings winner for the BBC — earning a perfect 100% rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Apple is now bringing this beloved series to audiences worldwide.

《Small Prophets》 will premiere its first two episodes on Apple TV on Wednesday, October 7, followed by one episode per week until November 4.

Apple released the trailer for 《Small Prophets》 today, giving viewers a sneak peek. Here's the synopsis, followed by the trailer:

《Small Prophets》 is created, written, and directed by Mackenzie Crook, who also created 《Detectorists》 and appeared in the British version of 《The Office》 and 《Pirates of the Caribbean》.

Note: 《Small Prophets》 will be available on Apple TV globally, but UK viewers will have to wait until 2027 to watch it.

Comedies currently airing on Apple TV include 《Brothers》 starring Matthew McConaughey and the fourth season of 《Ted Lasso》. The hit series 《Stick》 starring Owen Wilson will also be returning soon.

Apple TV costs $14.99 per month, or you can subscribe through the Apple One bundle for a discounted price.
